verdict.rationale: Feitian publishes a dedicated setup and registration guide library. It covers registering the key with online accounts in general, Microsoft and Azure AD accounts, Google Advanced Protection, Windows login, OpenSSH/GitHub, and Bluetooth pairing. Management tools such as SK Manager and iePassManager handle PIN and credential setup. The story allows clear instructions in place of a setup app, so these guides cover its core. Missing for 10: a guided setup wizard that walks the user through account registration end-to-end, any independent or hands-on corroboration that the guides are clear, and detail beyond index-page summaries of the guides.
